divergences.description: A bare launcher run with no --profile falls back to the slim profile, prints help, and exits 0, instead of reporting that a profile is required and exiting 1.
divergences.origin: Slim launcher, slim/full presets, privacy-off defaults, CLI rename
divergences.reason: The fork boots the slim profile by default and switches to the full profile with one explicit argument.

match.test: prints help for a bare run and rejects removed flags

divergences.description: Keep upstream launcher help entries and add slim/full presets with an optional default profile.
divergences.origin: Slim launcher, slim/full presets, privacy-off defaults, CLI rename
divergences.reason: The fork documents its default slim preset and optional full preset without removing supported upstream profile examples.

fork: layers under your own overrides. Without a profile it boots "slim".

lines: slim (default)   minimal one-shot preset installed with the launcher

insertions.after: dsh plugin --profile tui add <package>    install a plugin into the tui profile
lines: panedesk "run the tests"                       answer one task on the slim preset, print the result, and exit
panedesk --json "run the tests"                the same, printing newline-delimited JSON events
panedesk full "run the tests"                  the same task on the full preset (same as: panedesk --profile full ...)
panedesk --patch ./provider.yml "task"         add one overlay (e.g. a model provider) to the default preset
panedesk full --help                           the booted app's own flags and help
